signals.summary: A broad, persistent wave of 'what your cat is really telling you' explainer content decoding feline body language, moods and quirks. Renders naturally as candid clips of cats kneading, head-rubbing, doing zoomies, or sprawling on a laptop.
signals.why_now: Numerous independent outlets carry this theme across both the cat-behaviour and general feeds: The Spruce Pets ('Why Your Cat Might Not Be Covering Their Poop', 93h), BBC Science Focus ('How to make any cat instantly love you', 153h, plus 'stroking your cat wrong'), qz.com ('15 things your cat is trying to tell you'), Reader's Digest, PetMD ('Why Do Cats Get the Zoomies?'), DVM360 ('The misread cat'), and NYT. Evergreen and continually refreshed, it clears the age gate as recurring content.

signals.summary: A late-summer seasonal cluster of dogs showing off skills at state fairs and the start of fall training seasons. Produces well as candid action video of dogs running agility courses, weaving poles and clearing jumps.
signals.why_now: Three independent, very recent items converge on dogs performing and training as fair season peaks and fall classes open: Des Moines Register 'Iowa State Fair dogs put their best paws forward in agility demo' (12h), Brainerd Dispatch 'Fall dog training session is Sept. 7' (10h), and Idaho Statesman on a local judge headed to Westminster (42h). Seasonal timing (late August fairs, September training kickoff) clears the age gate.
